raw.title: Add priority field to Task model
raw.description: Add a priority field to the Task model. The priority field must be one of 'low', 'normal', 'high', with default 'normal'. Creating a Task with any other priority raises ValueError. to_dict/from_dict include priority, and from_dict of a dict with no 'priority' key gives 'normal' (files saved before this change must still load).

must_cover: Task with priority field is created correctly
Task.from_dict handles missing priority key by defaulting to 'normal'
Task.from_dict raises ValueError for invalid priority values
Task.to_dict includes priority field
Roundtrip serialization preserves priority

raw.title: Update TodoService to handle task priorities
raw.description: TodoService.add(title, tags=(), priority='normal') passes the priority to the new Task (and it is saved).

must_cover: TodoService.add creates Task with correct priority
Priority is saved and loaded correctly

raw.title: Add sorting functionality for tasks by priority
raw.description: Add sort_tasks(tasks, by='id') returning a new sorted list without changing the input. by='priority' sorts high, then normal, then low, ties broken by id ascending; by='title' sorts by title; by='id' by id. Any other `by` raises ValueError.

must_cover: sort_tasks with by='priority' sorts correctly by priority then id
sort_tasks with by='title' sorts by title
sort_tasks with by='id' sorts by id
sort_tasks with invalid by parameter raises ValueError

raw.title: Update task formatting for high priority tasks
raw.description: format_task puts '!' immediately before the title of a high-priority task, e.g. '  1 [ ] !Buy milk'. Other tasks format exactly as before.

must_cover: format_task formats high priority tasks with '!' prefix
format_task formats normal and low priority tasks without '!' prefix
format_task preserves existing formatting for other priority levels

raw.title: Update CSV export to include priority column
raw.description: to_csv gets a priority column right after title; the header becomes 'id,title,priority,done,tags'.

must_cover: to_csv includes priority column in correct position
to_csv header includes priority column
to_csv preserves existing functionality for other columns

raw.title: Add priority statistics function
raw.description: Add counts_by_priority(tasks) returning a dict with all three keys, e.g. {'high': 1, 'normal': 2, 'low': 0}.

must_cover: counts_by_priority returns dict with all three keys
counts_by_priority correctly counts tasks by priority
counts_by_priority returns 0 for unused priority levels

raw.title: Update CLI to support task priorities

must_cover: CLI add command accepts --priority flag
CLI list command accepts --sort flag
Default values work correctly for both commands
